from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """
    Represents one paper from the provided collection.
    Captures its title and which *other provided papers* it references.
    """
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this specific paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(
        description="List of titles of OTHER provided papers that are cited in this paper's reference list"
    )

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
